title: AR Science module
description: One lesson for the AR Science app. The app checks the same rules in ModuleCatalog.Validate (Assets/ARScience/Scripts/Core/ModuleDefinition.cs); keep the two in step when you change either.

$schema.description: Turns on autocomplete in VS Code. The app ignores it.

description.description: One line under the title in the Modules list.

type.description: placement = place shapes step by step. explore = place a model, turn it, zoom, tap its parts.

instructions.description: Help text shown at the top during the lesson.

requireHorizontalSurface.description: Only allow placing on floors and tables.

models.description: For explore lessons. More than one adds a Next model button.

item.description: What to place: cube, cylinder, pyramid, torus, wedge, arch (or any prefab in the Object Spawner).

prompt.description: What the student sees. Default "Place a <item>".

item.description: Prefab name in the Object Spawner, lower case, without "Variant" (e.g. "celldemo").

title.description: Shown while this model is on screen.

minZoom.description: Smallest pinch size, 1 = as placed. Default 0.5.

id.description: Name of the child object in the prefab. Case, spaces, _ and - don't matter.

name.description: Title shown when the part is tapped.

showFromZoom.description: Hidden until zoomed in this far (inner parts).

hideFromZoom.description: Hidden once zoomed in this far (outer shells).
